_meta.description: Local drug knowledge base for RxExplain. Covers commonly prescribed drugs in Indian outpatient practice, with Indian brand names, patient-facing purposes, adult dose ceilings and interaction partners.
_meta.dose_note: max_daily_dose values are conventional ADULT ceilings used only for coarse overdose screening in this project. They are not prescribing guidance and are not adjusted for weight, age, pregnancy, or kidney/liver function.
_meta.sources: Compiled from standard drug references (national formulary-style summaries, manufacturer package inserts and openFDA label text). Verified against openFDA labels at retrieval time where the drug exists there.

paracetamol.purpose: to bring down fever and to ease mild or moderate pain
paracetamol.how_it_works: It lowers the body's temperature setting and dulls pain signals.
serious_side_effects: liver damage if you take too much
rash or swelling from an allergic reaction
key_advice: Never take more than 4 grams (eight 500 mg tablets) in 24 hours.
Check other medicines you take for paracetamol in them, so you do not double up.
Avoid alcohol while taking it.

ibuprofen.purpose: to reduce pain, swelling and fever
ibuprofen.how_it_works: It blocks chemicals in the body that cause pain and swelling.
serious_side_effects: higher risk of heart attack or stroke with long use
key_advice: Always take it with food or milk to protect your stomach.
Stop and tell your doctor if you get black stools or vomit blood.
Use the lowest dose for the shortest time.

diclofenac.purpose: to relieve pain and swelling, often in joints, muscles or after an injury
diclofenac.how_it_works: It blocks chemicals in the body that cause pain and swelling.
key_advice: Take it after food.
Do not use it for longer than your doctor advises.

aceclofenac.purpose: to relieve joint and muscle pain and stiffness
aceclofenac.how_it_works: It blocks chemicals in the body that cause pain and swelling.
key_advice: Take it after food.
Tell your doctor if you get stomach pain that does not settle.

mefenamic acid.purpose: to relieve pain, fever and period cramps
mefenamic acid.how_it_works: It blocks chemicals in the body that cause pain and cramping.
key_advice: Take it after food.
Do not use it for more than 7 days at a stretch unless told to.

naproxen.purpose: to relieve longer-lasting pain and swelling, such as arthritis or gout
naproxen.how_it_works: It blocks chemicals in the body that cause pain and swelling.
key_advice: Take it with food.
Drink enough water through the day.

tramadol.purpose: to relieve moderate to severe pain when milder painkillers are not enough
tramadol.how_it_works: It changes the way your brain and nerves receive pain signals.
key_advice: Do not drive or operate machinery until you know how it affects you.
Do not drink alcohol with it.
Do not take more than prescribed, and do not stop suddenly after long use.

amoxicillin.purpose: to treat bacterial infections such as throat, chest, ear, sinus, dental or urine infections
amoxicillin.how_it_works: It kills bacteria by breaking down their protective outer wall.
serious_side_effects: severe allergic reaction with swelling or breathing difficulty
key_advice: Finish the whole course even if you feel better in two days.
Tell your doctor if you have ever reacted to penicillin.
Take the doses at evenly spaced times.

amoxicillin-clavulanate.class: Penicillin antibiotic with a resistance blocker
amoxicillin-clavulanate.purpose: to treat bacterial infections, including ones that no longer respond to plain amoxicillin
amoxicillin-clavulanate.how_it_works: The amoxicillin kills bacteria, and the clavulanic acid stops bacteria from destroying the amoxicillin.
serious_side_effects: liver irritation with yellowing of eyes
key_advice: Take it at the start of a meal to reduce stomach upset.
Finish the full course.
Tell your doctor about any penicillin allergy.

azithromycin.purpose: to treat chest, throat, sinus, skin and some sexually transmitted infections
azithromycin.how_it_works: It stops bacteria from making the proteins they need to grow.
key_advice: Usually a short 3 to 5 day course - finish all of it.
Take it at the same time each day, on an empty stomach or with food if it upsets you.
Do not take antacids within 2 hours of the dose.

cefixime.purpose: to treat throat, ear, chest and urine infections caused by bacteria
cefixime.how_it_works: It kills bacteria by damaging their outer wall.
key_advice: Take it after food.
Complete the full course.
Tell your doctor about any penicillin or cephalosporin allergy.

cephalexin.purpose: to treat skin, bone, ear and urine infections caused by bacteria
cephalexin.how_it_works: It kills bacteria by damaging their outer wall.
key_advice: Space the doses evenly.
Finish the full course.

ceftriaxone.purpose: to treat serious bacterial infections that need an injection
ceftriaxone.how_it_works: It kills bacteria by damaging their outer wall.
serious_side_effects: gallbladder or kidney stones with long use
key_advice: This is given by a nurse or doctor, not taken at home.
Tell the staff about any antibiotic allergy before the injection.

ciprofloxacin.purpose: to treat urine, stomach, bone and some chest infections
ciprofloxacin.how_it_works: It stops bacteria from copying their genetic material, so they cannot multiply.
serious_side_effects: tendon pain or rupture, especially at the heel
key_advice: Drink plenty of water through the day.
Stop and call your doctor if you get sudden heel, shoulder or wrist pain.
Do not take milk, antacids or iron within 2 hours of the dose.
Avoid strong sunlight.

levofloxacin.purpose: to treat chest, sinus, urine and skin infections
levofloxacin.how_it_works: It stops bacteria from copying their genetic material.
key_advice: Drink plenty of water.
Report sudden joint or tendon pain at once.
Keep antacids, iron and calcium at least 2 hours apart from the dose.

ofloxacin.purpose: to treat loose motions from infection, and urine or ear infections
ofloxacin.how_it_works: It stops bacteria from copying their genetic material.
key_advice: Drink plenty of fluids, especially if you have loose motions.
Avoid antacids and milk close to the dose.
Complete the course.

metronidazole.purpose: to treat infections from certain bacteria and parasites, including amoebic loose motions, dental and gut infections
metronidazole.how_it_works: It damages the genetic material of bacteria and parasites so they die.
serious_side_effects: numbness or tingling in hands and feet
key_advice: Do not drink any alcohol during the course or for 3 days after - it can cause severe vomiting and flushing.
Take it after food.
Finish the full course.

doxycycline.purpose: to treat acne, chest infections, and infections spread by ticks or mosquitoes
doxycycline.how_it_works: It stops bacteria from making the proteins they need to grow.
serious_side_effects: food pipe ulcers if taken lying down
key_advice: Take it with a full glass of water and stay upright for 30 minutes afterwards - do not lie down.
Use sunscreen and cover up in the sun.
Keep milk, antacids and iron at least 2 hours away from the dose.

norfloxacin.purpose: to treat urine infections and infective loose motions
norfloxacin.how_it_works: It stops bacteria from copying their genetic material.
key_advice: Take it on an empty stomach with plenty of water.
Complete the course.

albendazole.purpose: to clear worm infections from the gut
albendazole.how_it_works: It starves the worms of sugar so they cannot survive.
serious_side_effects: low white blood cell count with long courses
key_advice: Chew or crush the tablet and take it with food - fatty food helps it work.
Often the whole family is treated at the same time.
A single dose is usually enough for common worms.

fluconazole.purpose: to treat fungal infections such as thrush, ringworm and nail or skin fungus
fluconazole.how_it_works: It breaks down the outer covering of the fungus.
serious_side_effects: liver problems with yellowing of eyes
key_advice: For skin and nail fungus this is often a once-a-week tablet for several weeks - keep taking it even after the itching stops.
Tell your doctor about every other medicine you take, as it interacts with many.

acyclovir.purpose: to treat infections caused by herpes viruses, such as cold sores, genital herpes and chickenpox or shingles
acyclovir.how_it_works: It stops the virus from making copies of itself.
key_advice: Start it as early as possible for best effect.
Drink plenty of water while taking it.
Take the doses evenly spread through the day.

omeprazole.purpose: to cut down stomach acid, easing heartburn, acidity and ulcers
omeprazole.how_it_works: It switches off the acid pumps in the stomach lining.
serious_side_effects: vitamin B12 deficiency with long use
key_advice: Take it 30 to 60 minutes before food, usually before breakfast.
Swallow the capsule whole - do not chew it.
Do not stay on it long term without your doctor reviewing it.

pantoprazole.purpose: to cut down stomach acid and protect the stomach, easing acidity, heartburn and ulcers
pantoprazole.how_it_works: It switches off the acid pumps in the stomach lining.
serious_side_effects: vitamin B12 deficiency with long use
key_advice: Take it on an empty stomach, about 30 to 60 minutes before breakfast.
Swallow the tablet whole.
It is often given alongside painkillers to protect your stomach.

rabeprazole.purpose: to cut down stomach acid, easing acidity, heartburn and ulcers
rabeprazole.how_it_works: It switches off the acid pumps in the stomach lining.
key_advice: Take it before food, usually before breakfast.
Swallow the tablet whole.

sucralfate.purpose: to coat and protect ulcers in the stomach or food pipe so they can heal
sucralfate.how_it_works: It forms a protective layer over the raw area.
key_advice: Take it on an empty stomach, 1 hour before meals.
Keep other medicines at least 2 hours apart from it, as it can block their absorption.

domperidone.purpose: to stop nausea and vomiting and help the stomach empty faster
domperidone.how_it_works: It helps the stomach push food along and blocks the sickness signal in the gut.
key_advice: Take it 15 to 30 minutes before food.
Use it for the shortest time needed, usually no more than a week.

ondansetron.purpose: to stop severe nausea and vomiting
ondansetron.how_it_works: It blocks the chemical signal that triggers vomiting.
key_advice: The mouth-dissolving type is placed on the tongue and needs no water.
Tell your doctor if you have any heart rhythm problem.

dicyclomine.purpose: to relieve stomach cramps and spasms
dicyclomine.how_it_works: It relaxes the muscle in the gut wall.
key_advice: It can make you drowsy - be careful about driving.
Take it before food for cramps.

drotaverine.purpose: to relieve cramping pain in the stomach, gut, urinary tract or during periods
drotaverine.how_it_works: It relaxes tight smooth muscle, which eases the cramp.
key_advice: Take it when the cramp starts if it was prescribed as needed.
Sit or lie down if you feel dizzy after a dose.

metformin.purpose: to bring down blood sugar in type 2 diabetes
metformin.how_it_works: It lowers the sugar your liver releases and helps your body use insulin better.
serious_side_effects: a rare but serious build-up of acid in the blood, with deep breathing, severe weakness and stomach pain
vitamin B12 deficiency with long use
key_advice: Always take it with or just after food to reduce stomach upset.
Stop it and call your doctor if you are vomiting, dehydrated or about to have a scan with contrast dye or surgery.
Do not drink much alcohol.
Keep taking it even when your sugar readings look normal.

glimepiride.purpose: to bring down blood sugar in type 2 diabetes
glimepiride.how_it_works: It makes your pancreas release more insulin.
serious_side_effects: severe low blood sugar with confusion or fainting
key_advice: Take it just before or with breakfast - never skip the meal after taking it.
Learn the signs of low sugar: shaking, sweating, hunger, confusion. Keep sugar or glucose with you.
Check your sugar as advised.

sitagliptin.purpose: to bring down blood sugar in type 2 diabetes
sitagliptin.how_it_works: It helps your body release insulin at the right time after meals.
serious_side_effects: inflammation of the pancreas with severe stomach pain
key_advice: Can be taken with or without food, at the same time each day.
Report severe, lasting stomach pain at once.

insulin.purpose: to control blood sugar when tablets are not enough or in type 1 diabetes
insulin.how_it_works: It replaces or adds to the insulin your body cannot make in sufficient amounts.
common_side_effects: lumps or redness at the injection site
serious_side_effects: severe low blood sugar with fainting or fits
key_advice: Inject it under the skin, changing the spot each time so lumps do not form.
Never skip a meal after your dose.
Always keep glucose or sugar within reach for low sugar episodes.
Store the pen or vial in the fridge, but never freeze it.

amlodipine.purpose: to lower blood pressure and reduce chest pain from angina
amlodipine.how_it_works: It relaxes and widens your blood vessels so blood flows more easily.
common_side_effects: swelling of the ankles and feet
serious_side_effects: very low blood pressure with fainting
key_advice: Take it at the same time every day - it works only while you keep taking it.
Do not stop it because your blood pressure reading has become normal.
Get up slowly from sitting or lying to avoid dizziness.
Ankle swelling is common and not dangerous, but mention it at your review.

telmisartan.purpose: to lower blood pressure and protect the heart and kidneys
telmisartan.how_it_works: It blocks a hormone that tightens blood vessels, so the vessels stay relaxed.
serious_side_effects: high potassium with muscle weakness or irregular heartbeat
key_advice: Take it at the same time daily, with or without food.
Never take it if you are or might be pregnant - tell your doctor immediately.
Avoid painkillers like ibuprofen and diclofenac unless your doctor approves.
Get up slowly to avoid dizziness.

losartan.purpose: to lower blood pressure and protect the kidneys, especially in diabetes
losartan.how_it_works: It blocks a hormone that tightens blood vessels.
key_advice: Take it at the same time daily.
Never take it during pregnancy.
Avoid ibuprofen-type painkillers unless approved.

enalapril.purpose: to lower blood pressure and help a weak heart pump better
enalapril.how_it_works: It stops your body making a hormone that tightens blood vessels.
serious_side_effects: swelling of the face, lips or tongue
key_advice: A dry cough is a common side effect - tell your doctor, as a different medicine can be used.
Never take it in pregnancy.
Go to hospital at once if your face, lips or tongue swell.

ramipril.purpose: to lower blood pressure, protect the kidneys and reduce heart attack risk
ramipril.how_it_works: It stops your body making a hormone that tightens blood vessels.
serious_side_effects: swelling of face, lips or tongue
key_advice: Take the first dose at bedtime, as it can make you dizzy.
Report a persistent dry cough.
Never take it in pregnancy.

atenolol.purpose: to slow the heart rate, lower blood pressure and ease chest pain
atenolol.how_it_works: It shields the heart from adrenaline, so it beats more slowly and with less force.
serious_side_effects: masking of low blood sugar warning signs
key_advice: Never stop it suddenly - that can cause chest pain or a rise in blood pressure. Your doctor will reduce it slowly.
If you have diabetes, note that it can hide the shakiness that warns you of low sugar.
Tell your doctor if your pulse feels very slow.

metoprolol.purpose: to slow the heart, lower blood pressure, ease chest pain and protect the heart after a heart attack
metoprolol.how_it_works: It shields the heart from adrenaline, so it works less hard.
key_advice: Swallow the extended-release tablet whole - do not crush it.
Never stop it suddenly.
Take it with or just after food.

furosemide.purpose: to remove excess fluid from the body in heart, kidney or liver problems, and to help blood pressure
furosemide.how_it_works: It makes your kidneys pass out more salt and water as urine.
key_advice: Take it in the morning so you are not up all night passing urine.
Do not take the second dose late in the evening.
Weigh yourself regularly if your doctor asked you to.
Get your potassium and kidney blood tests done as advised.

spironolactone.class: Water tablet that keeps potassium (potassium-sparing diuretic)
spironolactone.purpose: to remove excess fluid in heart, liver or kidney problems, and sometimes for acne or hormonal conditions
spironolactone.how_it_works: It makes the kidneys pass out water and salt while holding on to potassium.
serious_side_effects: dangerously high potassium with muscle weakness or irregular heartbeat
key_advice: Avoid potassium supplements and salt substitutes.
Do not eat large amounts of banana, coconut water or citrus without asking your doctor.
Get your potassium blood test done as advised.

atorvastatin.purpose: to lower bad cholesterol and reduce the risk of heart attack and stroke
atorvastatin.how_it_works: It blocks the enzyme your liver uses to make cholesterol.
serious_side_effects: severe muscle pain with weakness and dark urine
key_advice: Take it at night, as your body makes most cholesterol then.
Report unexplained muscle pain, tenderness or weakness at once.
Avoid grapefruit juice.
Keep taking it long term - cholesterol rises again if you stop.

rosuvastatin.purpose: to lower bad cholesterol and reduce heart attack and stroke risk
rosuvastatin.how_it_works: It blocks the enzyme your liver uses to make cholesterol.
serious_side_effects: severe muscle breakdown with dark urine
key_advice: Can be taken at any time of day, but keep it the same time.
Report unexplained muscle pain or weakness at once.
Keep antacids at least 2 hours apart.
avoid_or_caution_if: Asian ancestry needs a lower starting dose

aspirin.purpose: to keep blood from clotting easily, lowering the risk of heart attack and stroke
aspirin.how_it_works: It stops platelets in your blood from sticking together.
serious_side_effects: stomach bleeding with black stools or blood in vomit
key_advice: Take it after food to protect your stomach.
Tell every doctor and dentist that you are on a blood thinner before any procedure.
Report black stools, blood in vomit or unusual bruising immediately.
Do not stop it on your own - that can trigger a clot.

clopidogrel.purpose: to prevent blood clots after a heart attack, stroke or stent
clopidogrel.how_it_works: It stops platelets in your blood from clumping into clots.
serious_side_effects: serious bleeding that will not stop
black stools or blood in vomit
key_advice: Never stop it on your own, especially after a stent - the risk of a clot is high.
Tell every doctor and dentist before any procedure.
Omeprazole can weaken it - pantoprazole is usually preferred if you need an acid reducer.
Report any bleeding that does not stop.

warfarin.purpose: to prevent and treat dangerous blood clots, for example with an artificial heart valve or an irregular heartbeat
warfarin.how_it_works: It slows down your body's clotting process by blocking the action of vitamin K.
key_advice: Your INR blood test must be done regularly - the dose is adjusted from it.
Keep your intake of green leafy vegetables steady rather than suddenly changing it.
Avoid alcohol and never add any new medicine, including painkillers or herbal products, without telling your doctor.
Report any unusual bleeding, dark stools or severe headache at once.

levothyroxine.purpose: to replace the thyroid hormone your body is not making enough of
levothyroxine.how_it_works: It supplies the thyroid hormone that controls your body's energy use.
common_side_effects: usually none at the right dose
serious_side_effects: signs of too much: fast heartbeat, tremor, weight loss, feeling hot, trouble sleeping
chest pain in people with heart disease
key_advice: Take it first thing in the morning on an empty stomach, with water, and wait 30 to 60 minutes before eating or drinking tea or coffee.
Keep calcium, iron and antacids at least 4 hours away from the dose.
This is usually lifelong - do not stop it when you feel well.
Get your thyroid blood test done as advised.

cetirizine.purpose: to relieve sneezing, runny nose, itching, hives and other allergy symptoms
cetirizine.how_it_works: It blocks histamine, the chemical your body releases during an allergic reaction.
key_advice: Take it at night, because it can make you sleepy.
Do not drive or use machinery if it makes you drowsy.
Avoid alcohol with it.

levocetirizine.purpose: to relieve allergy symptoms like sneezing, runny nose, itching and hives
levocetirizine.how_it_works: It blocks histamine, the chemical behind allergic reactions.
key_advice: Take it in the evening, as it can cause drowsiness.
Avoid alcohol.
Be careful about driving.

montelukast.purpose: to prevent asthma attacks and control long-lasting nasal allergy
montelukast.how_it_works: It blocks chemicals that tighten and inflame the airways.
serious_side_effects: mood or behaviour changes such as agitation, low mood, bad dreams or suicidal thoughts
key_advice: Take it in the evening, every day, even when you feel well.
This prevents attacks - it will NOT relieve an attack that has already started, so always keep your reliever inhaler with you.
Tell your doctor at once about any change in mood, sleep or behaviour.
avoid_or_caution_if: history of depression or mental health problems

salbutamol.purpose: to open up the airways quickly during breathlessness, wheezing or an asthma attack
salbutamol.how_it_works: It relaxes the tight muscles around your airways within minutes.
serious_side_effects: worsening wheeze right after the dose
key_advice: This is your RELIEVER - use it when you are breathless, and always carry it with you.
Shake the inhaler, breathe out fully, then press and breathe in slowly and deeply, and hold your breath for 10 seconds.
Wait a minute between puffs.
If you need it more than twice a week, or it stops helping, see your doctor - your asthma is not controlled.

budesonide-formoterol.purpose: to control asthma or COPD every day and keep the airways open and calm
budesonide-formoterol.how_it_works: The steroid settles swelling in the airways while the formoterol keeps them relaxed for about 12 hours.
key_advice: Rinse your mouth with water and spit it out after every dose, to prevent mouth thrush.
Use it every day even when you feel well - it prevents attacks rather than treating them.
Keep your separate quick-relief inhaler for sudden breathlessness.

prednisolone.purpose: to bring down strong inflammation in conditions like severe asthma, allergy, arthritis or skin disease
prednisolone.how_it_works: It powerfully damps down the body's inflammation and immune response.
serious_side_effects: bone thinning and cataracts with long use
key_advice: Take it in the morning after breakfast, to reduce stomach upset and sleep problems.
Never stop it suddenly if you have taken it for more than about 2 weeks - the dose must be reduced step by step.
If you have diabetes, check your sugar more often, as it will rise.
Tell your doctor about any sign of infection.

ambroxol.purpose: to thin sticky mucus so a chesty cough clears more easily
ambroxol.how_it_works: It makes the mucus in your airways thinner and easier to cough up.
key_advice: Drink plenty of warm water - it helps the medicine loosen the mucus.
Take it after food.
Do not use it together with a cough-suppressing syrup unless your doctor says so.

dextromethorphan.purpose: to quiet a dry, irritating cough
dextromethorphan.how_it_works: It calms the cough centre in the brain.
key_advice: Use it only for a dry cough, not a chesty cough with phlegm.
It can make you sleepy - avoid driving.
Do not exceed the dose on the label.

alprazolam.purpose: for short-term relief of severe anxiety or trouble sleeping
alprazolam.how_it_works: It calms overactive nerve signals in the brain.
serious_side_effects: dependence and withdrawal fits if stopped suddenly
dangerously slow breathing with alcohol or opioids
key_advice: Take it only at bedtime as prescribed, and only for the short period advised - it is habit-forming.
Never drink alcohol with it.
Do not drive or operate machinery.
Never stop it abruptly after regular use - your doctor must taper it.

clonazepam.purpose: to control certain fits, panic attacks or severe anxiety
clonazepam.how_it_works: It calms excessive electrical activity in the brain.
serious_side_effects: slow breathing with alcohol or opioids
key_advice: Take it exactly as prescribed - it is habit-forming.
Never stop it suddenly.
No alcohol.
Avoid driving until you know how it affects you.

sertraline.purpose: to treat depression, anxiety, panic attacks and obsessive-compulsive symptoms
sertraline.how_it_works: It raises the level of serotonin, a brain chemical that steadies mood.
serious_side_effects: worsening mood or suicidal thoughts, especially in the first weeks and in young people
serotonin syndrome with agitation, fever and stiffness
key_advice: It takes 2 to 4 weeks to start helping and up to 6 to 8 weeks for full effect - keep taking it even if you notice nothing at first.
Take it in the morning with food.
Never stop it suddenly - stopping causes dizziness and flu-like symptoms, so your doctor will reduce it slowly.
Tell your doctor at once if your mood gets worse or you have thoughts of harming yourself.

escitalopram.purpose: to treat depression and anxiety disorders
escitalopram.how_it_works: It raises serotonin, a brain chemical that steadies mood.
serious_side_effects: worsening mood or suicidal thoughts early in treatment
key_advice: Give it 2 to 4 weeks to work - do not judge it in the first week.
Take it at the same time daily, with or without food.
Never stop suddenly - it must be tapered.
Report worsening mood or self-harm thoughts immediately.

amitriptyline.class: Tricyclic antidepressant, also used for nerve pain
amitriptyline.purpose: to treat depression, and in low doses to ease nerve pain, migraine or long-standing headache
amitriptyline.how_it_works: It changes brain chemicals that affect both mood and how pain is felt.
key_advice: Take it at bedtime - it causes drowsiness, which also helps sleep.
For nerve pain, the dose is much lower than for depression, and it can take 2 to 4 weeks to help.
Get up slowly from bed to avoid dizziness.
Do not stop it suddenly.

pregabalin.purpose: to relieve burning or shooting nerve pain, and to help control fits
pregabalin.how_it_works: It calms overactive nerves that are sending pain signals.
key_advice: Do not drive until you know how drowsy it makes you.
It usually takes 1 to 2 weeks to help the pain.
Never stop it suddenly - it must be reduced gradually.
Avoid alcohol.

gabapentin.purpose: to relieve nerve pain and help control fits
key_advice: The dose is usually built up slowly over days - follow the step-up schedule exactly.
Do not drive until you know how it affects you.
Keep antacids at least 2 hours apart.
Do not stop suddenly.

phenytoin.how_it_works: It steadies the electrical activity in the brain that triggers fits.
serious_side_effects: severe skin rash that spreads or blisters
slurred speech and double vision from too high a level
key_advice: Take it exactly on time every day - missing doses can bring on a fit.
Brush and floss carefully, as it makes gums swell.
Stop and see a doctor immediately if you get a spreading skin rash.
Never stop it suddenly, and get your blood level checked as advised.

levetiracetam.how_it_works: It calms the abnormal bursts of electrical activity that cause fits.
serious_side_effects: marked mood or behaviour change including anger or depression
key_advice: Take it at the same two times each day, roughly 12 hours apart.
Tell your doctor about irritability, anger or low mood - this is a known effect.
Never stop it suddenly.

carbamazepine.class: Anti-seizure medicine, also used for nerve pain
carbamazepine.purpose: to prevent fits and to treat facial nerve pain (trigeminal neuralgia)
carbamazepine.how_it_works: It steadies overactive nerve signals in the brain and face.
serious_side_effects: severe skin rash that blisters or spreads
key_advice: Stop and get medical help immediately for any spreading rash, mouth ulcers or fever.
Take it with food.
It weakens many other medicines, including birth control pills - tell your doctor everything you take.
Get your blood tests done as advised.

allopurinol.purpose: to lower uric acid and prevent gout attacks and uric acid kidney stones
allopurinol.how_it_works: It reduces how much uric acid your body makes.
serious_side_effects: severe skin reaction with blistering and fever
key_advice: This PREVENTS gout - it does not treat an attack, and starting it can even trigger one at first.
Keep taking it during an attack if you were already on it.
Drink 2 to 3 litres of water daily.
Stop and see a doctor at once if you develop any rash.

febuxostat.purpose: to lower uric acid and prevent gout attacks
febuxostat.how_it_works: It blocks the enzyme that makes uric acid.
serious_side_effects: higher risk of heart problems in people with heart disease
key_advice: It prevents attacks rather than treating them - keep taking it even between attacks.
Drink plenty of water.
Tell your doctor if you have heart disease.

tamsulosin.class: Prostate and urine flow medicine (alpha blocker)
tamsulosin.purpose: to make passing urine easier when the prostate is enlarged
tamsulosin.how_it_works: It relaxes the muscle around the prostate and bladder outlet.
serious_side_effects: fainting from low blood pressure, especially with the first dose
key_advice: Take it 30 minutes after the same meal each day.
Take the first dose at bedtime and stand up slowly, as it can make you dizzy.
Tell your eye surgeon you take this before any cataract operation.
Swallow the capsule whole.

hydroxychloroquine.purpose: to control rheumatoid arthritis and lupus over the long term
hydroxychloroquine.how_it_works: It gently damps down the overactive immune response attacking your joints or skin.
serious_side_effects: eye damage affecting vision with long use
key_advice: Take it with food or milk.
You need an eye check-up before starting and then regularly - report any change in vision at once.
It works slowly and may take 2 to 3 months to help.
Keep taking it even when your joints feel better.

methotrexate.purpose: to control rheumatoid arthritis, psoriasis and some other immune conditions
methotrexate.how_it_works: It slows the overactive immune cells that damage joints and skin.
serious_side_effects: low blood counts with infection or bleeding
lung inflammation with dry cough and breathlessness
serious harm to an unborn baby
key_advice: This is a ONCE A WEEK medicine - taking it daily by mistake can be fatal. Fix one day of the week and never vary it.
Take your folic acid tablet on a different day, as prescribed.
Get your blood counts and liver tests done regularly.
Avoid alcohol completely, and do not become pregnant while on it.
Report any new cough, breathlessness, fever or mouth ulcers at once.

iron-folic-acid.purpose: to treat or prevent low blood (anaemia) from iron or folate deficiency
iron-folic-acid.how_it_works: It supplies the iron and folate your body needs to build healthy red blood cells.
common_side_effects: black stools, which is normal and harmless
serious_side_effects: dangerous overdose in children who swallow the tablets
key_advice: Take it on an empty stomach with lemon water or orange juice - vitamin C helps absorption.
Do NOT take it with tea, coffee, milk or calcium, which block iron; keep them 2 hours apart.
Black stools are expected - do not be alarmed.
It takes 2 to 3 months to correct the anaemia, so keep going.
Keep the bottle out of children's reach - iron overdose in children is life-threatening.

calcium-vitamin-d3.purpose: to keep bones and teeth strong, and to treat or prevent low calcium or vitamin D
calcium-vitamin-d3.how_it_works: Calcium builds bone, and vitamin D helps your gut absorb that calcium.
serious_side_effects: high calcium with confusion and weakness at very high doses
key_advice: Take it after food for better absorption.
Keep it at least 4 hours away from thyroid tablets and 2 hours from iron or antibiotics.
Drink enough water to reduce the risk of stones.
Some sunlight exposure helps your own vitamin D.

vitamin-b-complex.purpose: to correct or prevent B-vitamin deficiency, which can cause tiredness, mouth ulcers or nerve tingling
vitamin-b-complex.how_it_works: It replaces B vitamins your body needs for nerves, blood and energy release.
common_side_effects: bright yellow urine, which is harmless
serious_side_effects: nerve tingling with very high long-term B6
key_advice: Take it after food.
Yellow urine is just the extra vitamin being passed out - it is not a problem.
It is a supplement, not a treatment for tiredness on its own.

ors.purpose: to replace the water and salts lost through loose motions, vomiting or heat
ors.how_it_works: Its balance of salt and sugar helps your gut pull water back into the body.
common_side_effects: mild nausea if drunk too fast
serious_side_effects: salt imbalance if mixed far too strong
key_advice: Dissolve one full sachet in exactly 1 litre of clean drinking water - never less water, and never add sugar or salt.
Sip it slowly and steadily rather than gulping it.
Throw away any solution left after 24 hours and make it fresh.
Go to a doctor if there is no urine, sunken eyes, extreme weakness or blood in the stool.

clotrimazole.purpose: to treat fungal skin infections such as ringworm, athlete's foot, and vaginal or skin thrush
clotrimazole.how_it_works: It breaks down the outer wall of the fungus on the skin.
common_side_effects: mild burning or stinging where applied
key_advice: Apply a thin layer and rub it in gently over the rash AND about 2 cm of normal skin around it.
Wash and dry the area well before applying.
Keep using it for 1 to 2 weeks AFTER the rash clears, or it will come back.
Keep the area dry and wear loose cotton clothing.

mupirocin.purpose: to treat bacterial skin infections such as impetigo, infected cuts or boils
mupirocin.how_it_works: It kills the bacteria on the skin surface.
common_side_effects: stinging or burning at the site
key_advice: Clean the area gently, then apply a thin layer and cover with a dressing if advised.
Wash your hands before and after applying.
Do not use it for more than 10 days.
Do not use it in the eyes or nose unless specifically told to.

betamethasone.purpose: to settle red, itchy, inflamed skin conditions such as eczema or dermatitis
betamethasone.how_it_works: It reduces the inflammation in the skin that causes redness and itching.
common_side_effects: acne or extra hair at the site
serious_side_effects: steroid absorption with large-area long-term use
key_advice: Apply a very thin layer only to the affected patch, once or twice a day as told.
Do NOT use it on the face, groin or armpits unless your doctor specifically said to.
Use it for the short course prescribed - long use thins the skin permanently.
Never use it on a fungal or infected rash on its own.

xylometazoline.how_it_works: It shrinks the swollen blood vessels inside the nose.
common_side_effects: burning or dryness in the nose
serious_side_effects: rebound worse blockage if used too long
key_advice: Do NOT use it for more than 5 to 7 days - longer use makes the blockage worse and hard to treat.
Blow your nose gently first, then tilt your head back to put the drops in.
Use the paediatric strength for children only.

carboxymethylcellulose.purpose: to relieve dry, gritty or tired eyes
carboxymethylcellulose.how_it_works: It coats the eye surface with a moist protective film.
common_side_effects: brief blurring right after the drop
serious_side_effects: eye pain or lasting redness, which needs review
key_advice: Wash your hands, tilt your head back, pull the lower lid down and put the drop in the pocket - do not let the tip touch your eye.
If you use more than one eye drop, wait 5 minutes between them.
Remove contact lenses before use unless the drops are lens-friendly.
Discard the bottle 1 month after opening.

moxifloxacin-eye.purpose: to treat bacterial eye infection such as conjunctivitis
moxifloxacin-eye.how_it_works: It kills the bacteria on the surface of the eye.
key_advice: Do not let the dropper tip touch your eye or fingers, to keep it sterile.
Finish the course even if the redness settles.
Do not wear contact lenses during the infection.
Do not share the bottle or your towel with anyone.

lactulose.purpose: to relieve constipation by softening the stool
lactulose.how_it_works: It pulls water into the bowel, making the stool soft and easier to pass.
serious_side_effects: dehydration and salt imbalance with overuse
key_advice: Take it at bedtime with plenty of water - it usually works in 1 to 2 days, not immediately.
Drink 2 to 3 litres of water daily while using it.
Add fibre, fruit and walking to your routine rather than relying on it long term.

tranexamic-acid.purpose: to reduce heavy bleeding, such as heavy periods or bleeding after an injury or surgery
tranexamic-acid.how_it_works: It stops clots from breaking down too early, so bleeding slows.
serious_side_effects: blood clots in the legs or lungs
key_advice: Take it only on the heavy bleeding days as prescribed, not continuously.
Report leg pain, swelling, chest pain, breathlessness or any change in vision immediately.
Tell your doctor if you have ever had a clot.
